description: Wire snow_connector.py (built 2026-04-16) into the approval_workflow daemon per Section 5 inter-daemon communication rules. This is wiring work, NOT a rewrite of snow_connector.py. Must use write_service on :8772 for all state exchange. The wiring module MUST: (1) poll mcp_submissions for rows needing SNOW ticket creation; (2) call snow_connector to create ServiceNow inbound ticket; (3) write SNOW ticket ID back to mcp_submissions via write_service; (4) handle 5xx from snow_connector with exponential backoff (3 tries); (5) write heartbeat to service_health every 60s. Do NOT wire directly to approval_workflow — only to write_service.
